payload.intent:
Read the support transcript below and label it.

Answer with JSON only. Give the category — one of bug, feature, question or
billing — and your confidence as a number between 0 and 1.

The transcript:

[10:02] Customer: Hi — since yesterday our weekly digest email goes out
twice, about a minute apart. Same content both times.

[10:03] Agent: Thanks for flagging. Did anything change on your side
around then — schedule edits, new team members, a region change?

[10:05] Customer: We were moved to the EU region on Tuesday, the account
manager mentioned it. The duplicates started the morning after.

[10:06] Agent: That lines up with something we are tracking. Does it
happen for every recipient, or only some?

[10:09] Customer: Every recipient on the Monday digest. The daily one
looks fine so far.

[10:10] Agent: Understood. I can link this ticket to the tracking issue so
you get the fix notice. The duplicates are harmless but noisy — the
scheduler registers twice after a region move.

[10:12] Customer: Fine as long as it stops. Is there a date?

[10:13] Agent: The fix is scheduled for the next patch release, targeted
this month. The ticket will update when it ships.

[10:14] Customer: OK, thanks. Please do link it, our ops channel is tired
of deleting the second copy.
